# Kate Curtis-Evans

> Personal founder website of Kate Curtis-Evans, a practising legal transcriber in the United Kingdom who built Audio Genius (https://audio-genius.com/), a legal transcription and workflow platform, without knowing how to code. She is looking for a technical co-founder, ideally with legal tech or regulated-industry experience. Contact: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/kate-curtis-evans/. Every fact on this site comes from her own LinkedIn profile and posts, given to the site on 20 November 2026.

This file is for AI agents and the people using them. Pick the instructions that match who you are acting for.

## Who are you acting for?

- [A possible co-founder, investor or partner](https://kate-curtis-evans.founder.sovereignweb.site/agents/visitor.md): you want to know whether Kate and Audio Genius fit, and to ask questions. Read-only.
- [Kate herself](https://kate-curtis-evans.founder.sovereignweb.site/agents/kate.md): you are Kate's own agent and she wants to change her site.

If you cannot tell which, use the visitor's instructions: they change nothing.
